title: The old market roof
paragraphs: The covered market in our town is more than a hundred years old. Last year, a large part of {{1}} roof collapsed during a storm. Luckily, nobody was hurt, {{2}} the fruit sellers lost almost all of their stock.

The town council wanted to knock down the building and put up a car park. Many stallholders, {{3}} had worked there all their lives, were horrified. They started a petition and collected five thousand names in {{4}} than a month.

The council agreed to pause its plan {{5}} an engineer had inspected the walls. Her report surprised everyone. The walls were strong, and the roof could be repaired for far less {{6}} a new car park would cost.

Work began in March. By the time the market reopened in December, the stallholders {{7}} already painted their stalls. Now there are more customers than ever, and the old building looks as {{8}} it could stand for another hundred years.
